---
title: "Vectors"
---

Vectors are the simplest data structure in R: scalars don't exist in R. A vector is simply an ordered collection of
values with the same type (e.g., all numbers, all character strings, all boolean values).

Whenever you're working with R, you're almost always using vectors, whether you realize it or not. Vectors are very
simple objects, but the more complex objects you'll encounter later (matrices, lists, data frames, and factors) are all
built from vectors. Getting comfortable with vectors now will certainly pay off as you progress in your R journey.
